title: Kathy E. Johnson, Ph.D., Appointed Executive Vice President and Provost of Saint Louis University
summary_en: Johnson is currently the president of the University of New Orleans and previously served as the executive vice chancellor and chief academic officer at IU Indianapolis. As Saint Louis University’s second-ranking officer, Johnson will work closely with SLU’s president to help shape the University’s long-term direction.
title_cn: Kathy E. Johnson, Ph.D., Appointed Executive Vice President and Provost of Saint Louis University

title: SLU Researcher Serves as Scientist in Residence for the Saint Louis Science Center's 'The Blue Whale Story,' Which Opens Saturday
summary_en: SLU professor of physics Jean Potvin, Ph.D., has spent years studying the science of whales. Soon, St. Louis residents can hear directly from him. As a part of the Saint Louis Science Center's new traveling exhibition, The Blue Whale Story, opening this weekend, Potvin is serving as scientist in residence.
title_cn: SLU Researcher Serves as Scientist in Residence for the Saint Louis Science Center's 'The Blue Whale Story,' Which Opens Saturday
